title: User-approved app publication, storage and scoped connectors
whatBuilt: EXPLICIT APPROVAL REQUIRED: owner requests publication bound to the exact artifact digest + revision; custodian approves; no self-publication, no model-initiated publication

CREDENTIAL REFS STAY PRIVATE: connector credentials stored as vault REFS (starting with 'vault:'), never raw values; non-owner/reviewer cannot read refs; published payload contains credential REFS only (credentialValuesExposed: false)
STALE / REVOKED APPROVALS FAIL SAFELY: wrong digest/revision approval refused; revocation after publication marks the artifact REVOKED and stops serving; revoked approval refuses re-publication
DUPLICATE PUBLICATION REFUSED: same artifact+revision cannot be published twice
SCOPED CONNECTORS: storage/database/api connectors registered with vault credential refs; unregistered connector refs refuse publication
ROLLBACK: deterministic rollback to an earlier PUBLISHED revision; forward rollback refused; user records unchanged

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 317/317 pass (303 previous + 16 publication)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: The publication authority is the CONTRACT plane; actual hosted deployment/export (real connector invocation, real storage) remains a separate hosted gate. No public model endpoint is exposed. Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
